entries.label: AB
entries.desc: At-bats: PA minus walks, HBP, sacrifices and catcher's interference.

entries.label: OBP
entries.desc: (H + BB + IBB + HBP) / (AB + BB + IBB + HBP + SF).

entries.label: wOBA
entries.desc: Savant's woba_value summed over woba_denom: linear weights of each PA result, scaled to OBP.

entries.label: Zone% seen
entries.desc: Share of pitches seen in the strike zone (Savant zones 1-9).

entries.label: Z-Swing%
entries.desc: Swings at pitches in the zone.

entries.label: Chase%
entries.desc: Swings at pitches outside the zone (O-Swing%).

entries.label: Contact%
entries.desc: Contact (fouls and balls in play) per swing.

entries.label: Z-Contact%
entries.desc: Contact per swing in the zone.

entries.label: O-Contact%
entries.desc: Contact per swing outside the zone.

entries.label: Whiff%
entries.desc: Swinging strikes (incl. foul tips) per swing.

entries.label: CSW% against
entries.desc: Called strikes plus whiffs per pitch.

entries.label: First-pitch swing%
entries.desc: Swings at the first pitch of a PA.

entries.label: First-pitch strike% seen
entries.desc: First pitches that were strikes (called, swinging, foul or in play).

entries.label: Two-strike whiff%
entries.desc: Whiffs per swing with two strikes.

entries.label: Heart swing%
entries.desc: Swings at pitches in the heart of the zone (attack zones).

entries.label: Chase-zone swing%
entries.desc: Swings in the chase band (133-200 % of the zone).

entries.label: Waste swing%
entries.desc: Swings at waste pitches (beyond 200 % of the zone).

entries.label: Decision value
entries.desc: Runs gained by swing/take choices alone (swing model, centred on the league): for every pitch, the run value of the choice made minus the expected value of the league's swing probability there; contact quality is excluded.

entries.label: Zone decisions
entries.desc: Decision value on pitches in the zone.

entries.label: Chase decisions
entries.desc: Decision value on pitches outside the zone.

entries.label: Expected swing%
entries.desc: The league swing probability for the pitches he saw (location, count, pitch shape).

entries.label: Swing% over expected
entries.desc: Swing% minus expected swing%: aggression beyond what the pitches called for.

entries.label: Bad-take rate
entries.desc: Share of his takes on which swinging had the higher expected run value (lower is better).

entries.label: Bad-swing rate
entries.desc: Share of his swings on which taking had the higher expected run value.

entries.label: Exit velocity
entries.desc: Mean exit velocity on balls in play.

entries.label: Launch angle SD
entries.desc: Spread of launch angles (lower = more consistent).

entries.label: Barrel%
entries.desc: Barrels (Savant launch_speed_angle 6: the speed/angle combinations worth a .500 AVG and 1.500 SLG) per ball in play.

entries.label: xwOBA+ (ours)
entries.desc: Our expected wOBA: each ball in play scored from exit velocity, launch angle, hang time, the park (its five fence distances, mean wall height, elevation and roof) and sprint speed; walks, HBP and strikeouts at their wOBA values.

entries.label: xwOBA+ (park-neutral)
entries.desc: xwOBA+ with every ball re-scored in a standard park (330/375/400 ft, 8 ft walls, median elevation, open roof).

entries.label: xwOBA (Savant)
entries.desc: Savant's xwOBA (estimated_woba_using_speedangle on balls in play).

entries.label: xwOBA+ minus xwOBA (Savant)
entries.desc: xwOBA+ minus Savant's xwOBA: what hang time, the park and sprint speed add to exit velocity and launch angle.

entries.label: wOBA minus xwOBA+
entries.desc: Results above expectation (positive = outperforming contact quality; regresses).

entries.label: xwOBAcon (Savant)
entries.desc: Savant's xwOBA on balls in play.

entries.label: GB%
entries.desc: Ground balls per ball in play.

entries.label: Pull%
entries.desc: Spray angle more than 15 degrees to the pull side.

entries.label: Oppo%
entries.desc: More than 15 degrees to the opposite field.

entries.label: Pull-air%
entries.desc: Pulled line drives and fly balls per ball in play (the most valuable batted-ball direction).

entries.label: Oppo-air%
entries.desc: Opposite-field line drives and fly balls.

entries.label: Bat speed
entries.desc: Mean bat speed (sweet spot, competitive swings with 50+ mph).

entries.label: Adjusted bat speed
entries.desc: Bat speed relative to the expectation for his pitches (count, location, pitch speed), shrunk with 50 swings, plus the league mean.

entries.label: Adjusted swing length
entries.desc: Swing length relative to the expectation for his pitches.

entries.label: Squared-up% (contact)
entries.desc: Contact with 80 %+ of the attainable exit velocity (1.23 bat speed + 0.23 pitch speed).

entries.label: Squared-up over expected
entries.desc: Squared-up rate minus the model's expectation for the pitches he made contact with.

entries.label: Attack angle
entries.desc: Vertical angle of the bat's path at contact.

entries.label: Path mismatch
entries.desc: Mean |attack angle + pitch VAA|: how far his swing plane is from the pitch plane.

entries.label: Path matched%
entries.desc: Swings within 5 degrees of the pitch plane.

entries.label: Attack direction
entries.desc: Horizontal angle of the bat path (+ toward the pull side).

entries.label: Contact point (rel.)
entries.desc: Intercept point in front of the body relative to the league (in; + = out front).

entries.label: xwOBA v fastballs
entries.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with fastballs.

entries.label: Run value/100 v fastballs
entries.desc: Batting run value (Savant delta_run_exp) per 100 fastballs seen.

entries.label: Chase% v fastballs
entries.desc: Swings at fastballs outside the zone.

entries.label: xwOBA v breaking balls
entries.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with breaking balls.

entries.label: Whiff% v breaking balls
entries.desc: Whiffs per swing v breaking balls.

entries.label: Run value/100 v breaking balls
entries.desc: Batting run value (Savant delta_run_exp) per 100 breaking balls seen.

entries.label: Chase% v breaking balls
entries.desc: Swings at breaking balls outside the zone.

entries.label: xwOBA v offspeed
entries.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with offspeed.

entries.label: Run value/100 v offspeed
entries.desc: Batting run value (Savant delta_run_exp) per 100 offspeed seen.

entries.label: Chase% v offspeed
entries.desc: Swings at offspeed outside the zone.

entries.label: xwOBA v 95+ mph
entries.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with a pitch at 95+ mph.

entries.label: xwOBA v 90-95 mph
entries.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with a pitch at 90-95 mph.

entries.label: xwOBA v under 90 mph
entries.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with a pitch at under 90 mph.

entries.label: Whiff% v under 90 mph
entries.desc: Whiffs per swing at under 90 mph.

entries.label: Run value/100 (heart)
entries.desc: Batting run value per 100 pitches in the heart attack zone.

entries.label: Run value/100 (shadow)
entries.desc: Batting run value per 100 pitches in the shadow attack zone.

entries.label: Run value/100 (chase)
entries.desc: Batting run value per 100 pitches in the chase attack zone.

entries.label: Run value/100 (waste)
entries.desc: Batting run value per 100 pitches in the waste attack zone.

entries.label: Shadow swing%
entries.desc: Swings at pitches on the edges (shadow attack zone).

entries.label: PA share v LHP
entries.desc: Share of his PAs against left-handers.

entries.label: Platoon gap
entries.desc: |wOBA v same-handed pitchers - wOBA v opposite-handed| (switch hitters: |v LHP - v RHP|).

entries.label: WPA
entries.desc: Win probability added: the change in our win expectancy (Markov model on inning, half, outs, bases, score) over his PAs.

entries.label: WPA/LI
entries.desc: Context-neutral wins: sum of WPA / leverage.

entries.label: pLI
entries.desc: Average leverage index of his PAs (1 = average).

entries.label: RE24
entries.desc: Run expectancy added over his PAs (runs).

entries.label: Sprint speed
entries.desc: Savant sprint speed (ft/s, top two-thirds of competitive runs).

entries.label: Baserunning runs
entries.desc: Steals (wSB) plus extra bases taken on hits against the league for the same hit, base and outs (builder C).

entries.label: Extra-base runs
entries.desc: Runs from taking extra bases on hits.

entries.label: SB (est.)
entries.desc: Stolen bases detected in the pitch data (estimated).

entries.label: CS (est.)
entries.desc: Caught stealing detected in the pitch data (estimated).

entries.label: OAA
entries.desc: Outs above average from our catch-probability model (landing spot, hang time, alignment-inferred start).

entries.label: Fielding runs
entries.desc: OAA converted to runs with the season's linear weights.

entries.label: OAA toward 3B
entries.desc: OAA moving toward the third-base line.

entries.label: OAA toward 1B
entries.desc: OAA moving toward the first-base line.

entries.label: Savant OAA
entries.desc: Savant's published outs above average (for comparison).

entries.label: Framing runs
entries.desc: Catchers: called strikes added over the league surface (location, count, pitch, umpire, pitcher, batter effects) times the run value of a strike.

entries.label: Strike rate added
entries.desc: Catchers: strikes added per called pitch.

entries.label: WAR
entries.desc: Bullpen WAR (regressed): (batting + baserunning + fielding + framing + positional + league + replacement runs) / runs per win, with batting from regressed park-neutral xwOBA+.

entries.label: WAR (results)
entries.desc: Bullpen WAR with results-based batting runs (wOBA, park-adjusted) in place of the regressed xwOBA+ batting runs.

entries.label: Batting runs
entries.desc: True-talent batting runs: park-neutral xwOBA+ regressed with the stabilisation PA, against the league, per PA.

entries.label: Positional runs
entries.desc: Positional adjustment prorated by games at each position.

entries.label: Projected wOBA
entries.desc: Next-season wOBA from the component projections (each skill regressed at its own rate, aging applied).

entries.label: Preseason projected wOBA
entries.desc: The projection made before this season from earlier seasons only.

entries.label: IP
entries.desc: Innings pitched (outs / 3; shown as decimal innings).

entries.label: R
entries.desc: Runs scored while he pitched (no inherited-runner reassignment).

entries.label: FIP
entries.desc: Fielding-independent pitching on the RA9 scale.

entries.label: xFIP
entries.desc: FIP with home runs replaced by fly balls x league HR/FB.

entries.label: Pitching+
entries.desc: Expected run value of each pitch from stuff, location, count and sequence together (count-neutral), scaled 100 = league average, 10 = one SD of pitcher-pitch-type means.

entries.label: Stuff+
entries.desc: Expected run value from the pitch's physical characteristics alone (velocity, movement, spin, extension, release, arm angle, VAA, differences from his fastball), per pitch family, scaled like Pitching+.

entries.label: Location+
entries.desc: Expected run value of the location given count, pitch family and platoon, scaled like Pitching+.

entries.label: xRV/100
entries.desc: Pitching model expected runs per 100 pitches relative to the count (negative is good for the pitcher).

entries.label: RV/100
entries.desc: Actual run value per 100 pitches (Savant delta_run_exp, batting side: lower is better).

entries.label: Best secondary Stuff+
entries.desc: Highest Stuff+ among his non-fastballs thrown 5 %+ of the time.

entries.label: Max velo
entries.desc: Fastest pitch (95th percentile of his primary fastball).

entries.label: Fastball arm-side run
entries.desc: Horizontal break toward the arm side.

entries.label: Fastball VAA
entries.desc: Vertical approach angle at the plate (flatter = closer to 0 = harder to hit up in the zone).

entries.label: Fastball spin efficiency
entries.desc: Share of spin that produces movement (transverse spin over total), from the trajectory fit.

entries.label: Fastball seam-shifted wake
entries.desc: Gap between the observed movement direction and the measured spin axis.

entries.label: Pitch types
entries.desc: Pitch types thrown 5 %+ of the time.

entries.label: FB-offspeed velo gap
entries.desc: Primary fastball minus his slowest regular pitch.

entries.label: Release spread
entries.desc: SD of the release point (in): lower = more repeatable.

entries.label: Release gap between types
entries.desc: Largest distance between two pitch types' mean release points (tipping risk).

entries.label: Tunnel index
entries.desc: Separation of consecutive pitches at the plate relative to their separation at the decision point (167 ms before the plate), against the league curve; 100 = average, 10 = one SD.

entries.label: Tunnel score (in)
entries.desc: Plate separation beyond what the decision-point gap predicts.

entries.label: Fastball% ahead
entries.desc: Fastball share when ahead in the count.

entries.label: Z-Swing%
entries.desc: Swings at his pitches in the zone.

entries.label: CSW%
entries.desc: Called strikes plus whiffs per pitch.

entries.label: Z-Contact%
entries.desc: Contact per swing in the zone.

entries.label: Edge%
entries.desc: Pitches in the shadow attack zone.

entries.label: Heart%
entries.desc: Pitches in the heart of the zone.

entries.label: Waste%
entries.desc: Pitches in the waste attack zone.

entries.label: O-Contact% allowed
entries.desc: Contact per swing outside the zone.

entries.label: Two-strike whiff%
entries.desc: Whiffs per swing with two strikes.

entries.label: Chase-band%
entries.desc: Pitches in the chase attack zone (133-200 % of the zone).

entries.label: BF share v LHB
entries.desc: Share of batters faced who hit left-handed.

entries.label: RV/100 fastballs
entries.desc: Run value per 100 fastballs (batting side: lower is better).

entries.label: CSW% fastballs
entries.desc: Called strikes plus whiffs per fastballs.

entries.label: xwOBA fastballs
entries.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with fastballs.

entries.label: RV/100 breaking balls
entries.desc: Run value per 100 breaking balls (batting side: lower is better).

entries.label: Whiff% breaking balls
entries.desc: Whiffs per swing on breaking balls.

entries.label: CSW% breaking balls
entries.desc: Called strikes plus whiffs per breaking balls.

entries.label: xwOBA breaking balls
entries.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with breaking balls.

entries.label: RV/100 offspeed
entries.desc: Run value per 100 offspeed (batting side: lower is better).

entries.label: CSW% offspeed
entries.desc: Called strikes plus whiffs per offspeed.

entries.label: xwOBA offspeed
entries.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with offspeed.

entries.label: GB%
entries.desc: Ground balls per ball in play.

entries.label: Pull-air% allowed
entries.desc: Pulled line drives and fly balls.

entries.label: xwOBA+ against (ours)
entries.desc: Our expected wOBA allowed (see hitters' xwOBA+).

entries.label: xwOBA+ against (park-neutral)
entries.desc: xwOBA+ allowed in a standard park.

entries.label: wOBA minus xwOBA+
entries.desc: Results allowed above expectation (positive = unlucky or poor defence).

entries.label: xRA9
entries.desc: Expected runs per nine from xwOBA+ against (builder C's xruns over innings).

entries.label: xwOBA 1st time through
entries.desc: xwOBA allowed the first time through the order, shrunk with 100 PA to the league's TTO1.

entries.label: Velo change /100 pitches
entries.desc: Within-game fastball velocity slope per 100 pitches, shrunk to the league (mph).

entries.label: Spin change /100 pitches
entries.desc: Within-game fastball spin slope per 100 pitches (rpm).

entries.label: Velo last 3 games
entries.desc: Last three games' fastball velocity minus his season mean.

entries.label: Spin last 3 games
entries.desc: Last three games' spin minus his season mean.

entries.label: Release height drift
entries.desc: Last three games' release height minus season mean (in).

entries.label: Velo trend /30 days
entries.desc: Season slope of game fastball velocity per 30 days.

entries.label: Workload flag
entries.desc: 1 when the last three games' velocity is 1+ mph or spin 75+ rpm below his season baseline (descriptive, not medical).

entries.label: WAR (RA9)
entries.desc: Bullpen WAR, results-based (RA9): runs allowed against a replacement RA9 solved so pitchers share 43 % of 1,000 WAR per 2,430 games, park-adjusted, relievers scaled by (1 + gmLI) / 2.

entries.label: WAR (xwOBA+)
entries.desc: Bullpen WAR, regressed: expected runs from xwOBA+ against instead of runs allowed.

entries.label: gmLI
entries.desc: Average leverage index when entering a game (relievers).

entries.label: RE24 saved
entries.desc: Run expectancy saved over his PAs.

entries.label: pLI
entries.desc: Average leverage of the PAs he pitched.

entries.label: Projected HR/BF
entries.desc: Next-season home runs per batter faced.

entries.label: Preseason projected wOBA
entries.desc: The projection made before this season.

entries.label: Chances
entries.desc: Balls credited to him: outs made plus shares of balls not turned into outs.

entries.label: OAA back
entries.desc: OAA on balls moving away from the plate.

entries.label: OAA toward 3B
entries.desc: OAA moving toward the third-base line.

entries.label: OAA toward 1B
entries.desc: OAA moving toward the first-base line.

entries.label: Framing runs
entries.desc: Our framing runs (called-strike model with catcher, umpire, pitcher and batter effects).

entries.label: Offence (runs/game)
entries.desc: Batting plus baserunning runs above average per game.

entries.label: Defence (runs/game)
entries.desc: Fielding plus framing runs per game.

entries.label: Pitching (runs/game)
entries.desc: Expected runs saved by the pitchers per game.

entries.label: xwOBA+ (ours)
entries.desc: Our xwOBA, PA-weighted over the team's hitters.

entries.label: Pull-air%
entries.desc: Pulled line drives and fly balls.

entries.label: Decision value
entries.desc: Sum of the hitters' decision value (runs).

entries.label: Baserunning runs
entries.desc: Sum of the hitters' baserunning runs.

entries.label: Batting WPA
entries.desc: Win probability added by the hitters.

entries.label: CSW%
entries.desc: Called strikes plus whiffs per pitch.

entries.label: Barrel% allowed
entries.desc: Barrels allowed per ball in play.

entries.label: Pitching RV/100
entries.desc: Run value allowed per 100 pitches (batting side).

entries.label: Pitching WPA
entries.desc: Win probability added by the pitchers.

entries.label: Savant OAA
entries.desc: Sum of Savant OAA of the team's fielders.

entries.label: Position-player WAR
entries.desc: Sum of Bullpen WAR of the hitters.

entries.label: Pitcher WAR
entries.desc: Sum of RA9-based Bullpen WAR of the pitchers.

entries.label: Postseason odds
entries.desc: Probability of reaching the postseason (season simulation).

entries.label: World Series odds
entries.desc: Probability of winning the World Series.

entries.label: Called pitches
entries.desc: Called pitches (balls and called strikes) with a location.

entries.label: Accuracy
entries.desc: Calls matching the rulebook zone (plate half-width plus a ball radius; the batter's zone top and bottom +/- 0.12 ft).

entries.label: Expected accuracy
entries.desc: Accuracy the league surface (without his effect) would have had on his pitches.

entries.label: Consistency
entries.desc: Calls agreeing with his own fitted zone (league surface plus his effect).

entries.label: Zone size (+strikes/100)
entries.desc: Called strikes above the league expectation per 100 called pitches.

entries.label: Run impact/game
entries.desc: Absolute run-expectancy swing of missed calls per game.

entries.label: Zone effect (log-odds)
entries.desc: His random effect in the called-strike model (+ = more strikes).

model.label: Stuff+
model.desc: LightGBM models per pitch family (fastball, breaking, offspeed) of swing, whiff, foul, called-strike and in-play xwOBA probabilities from physical characteristics only, combined into an expected run value per pitch with the training seasons' run values of each outcome; trained on the seasons before the one scored; 100 = league average, 10 = one SD of pitcher-pitch-type quality.

model.label: Location+
model.desc: Expected run value of the location (batter-relative horizontal position, height in the batter's zone) given count, pitch family and platoon, relative to the count's average; scaled like Stuff+.

model.label: Pitching+
model.desc: Stuff, location, count and sequence (the previous pitch's type, speed and movement differences and the trajectory gaps at the decision point and at the plate) in one model of the de-lucked run value.

model.label: Trajectory physics
model.desc: Every pitch rebuilt from Savant's nine-parameter fit (constant acceleration): approach angles, induced vertical and horizontal break with gravity removed, plate speed, flight time, the decision-point position 167 ms before the plate, spin efficiency and the seam-shifted-wake gap between observed movement and spin axis.

model.label: Tunneling
model.desc: For consecutive pitches of a plate appearance, the distance between their positions at the decision point against their distance at the plate; the tunnel score is the plate separation beyond the league curve's expectation for the decision-point gap.

model.label: Swing decisions
model.desc: P(swing) and the run values of swinging and taking at each location, count and pitch shape (LightGBM); decision value = run value of the choice minus the league-expected value at that pitch.

model.label: Bat tracking (adjusted)
model.desc: Bat speed and swing length relative to expectations for count, location and pitch speed (shrunk with 50 swings); squared-up = exit velocity at 80 %+ of 1.23 bat speed + 0.23 pitch speed; swing path against the pitch plane (attack angle + VAA).

model.label: xwOBA+ (ours)
model.desc: Multiclass LightGBM (out, 1B, 2B, 3B, HR) on exit velocity, launch angle, hang time, the park (its five fence distances, mean wall height, elevation and roof) and sprint speed; cross-fitted by game, raked so each class's league share is exact, weighted with the season's wOBA values. The ball's direction is not a feature. Shown next to xwOBA (Savant); the predictive test is on the Calibration page.

model.label: Catch probability and OAA
model.desc: P(out) for every batted ball from landing spot, hang time and the fielder's distance and speed required from his alignment-inferred start; OAA = outs minus the summed probabilities, credited to the responsible fielder; fielding runs with the season's linear weights.

model.label: Framing and umpires
model.desc: A penalised logistic called-strike surface (location by batter hand, count, pitch family, hands) with catcher, umpire, pitcher and batter random effects; framing = strikes added by the catcher's effect times the run value of a strike; umpire accuracy against the rulebook zone, expected accuracy from the surface.

model.label: Run and win expectancy
model.desc: RE24 from complete half-innings; linear and wOBA weights per season (wOBA scaled to OBP); win expectancy from a Markov model of half-inning run distributions (automatic runner in extra innings from 2020); leverage index normalised to 1; WPA per plate appearance.

model.label: Bullpen WAR
model.desc: Batting from regressed park-neutral xwOBA+, baserunning (steals and extra bases taken), fielding (OAA runs) and framing, positional adjustment, a league adjustment to zero, and replacement level at 57 % of 1,000 WAR per 2,430 games for position players and 43 % for pitchers (RA9- and xwOBA+-based).

model.label: Park factors
model.desc: Contact factors per outcome and batter hand from observed over park-neutral expected counts (regressed with pseudo-events, three seasons); runs, K and BB from home and road games.

model.label: Projections
model.desc: Component projections (K, BB, HBP, ground balls, xwOBAcon, HR per ball in play, hits and extra bases on balls in play, bat speed), each regressed at its own stabilisation rate over three weighted seasons, slow components shrunk toward targets predicted by fast ones, aging curves fitted by the delta method, Triple-A counts translated.

model.label: Game model
model.desc: A plate-appearance Monte Carlo (20,000 games) with projected lineups, the starter's pitch-count exit model, bullpen tiers by availability, park, weather, umpire and home field; outputs win, run line, total and first-five distributions.

model.label: Live win probability
model.desc: An exact Markov chain over half-inning run distributions from the pre-game spec's lineups and pitchers, evaluated at every plate appearance's state (inning, outs, bases, score).

model.label: Season and postseason simulation
model.desc: Unplayed games and the 12-team bracket simulated with game-model or rating probabilities and a team-strength error held for the season; series odds in closed form; magic numbers deterministic; next-game odds interventional.

model.label: Award races
model.desc: A conditional logit over each league's candidates on Bullpen WAR, traditional voting features and team success, fitted on verified past winners.

model.label: Percentiles
model.desc: 100 = best, reversed where lower is better; placed against the reference pool (hitters with 2.1 PA per team game, pitchers with 1.25 BF per team game) after shrinking the value toward the pool mean with the metric's stabilisation constant: (n v + k m) / (n + k); a metric needs its sample floor (e.g. 50 PA, 25 balls in play) before it gets a percentile. pct_role compares hitters at the same position group and pitchers in the same role (SP / RP).

model.label: Stabilisation
model.desc: The sample at which split-half reliability reaches 0.7: r(n) = n / (n + k), n_0.7 = 0.7 k / 0.3, k fitted per metric over seasons (builder C).

model.label: Qualified
model.desc: MLB's rules: 3.1 PA per team game (hitters), 1 inning per team game (pitchers).

model.label: Attack zones
model.desc: Heart (inner 67 % of the zone), shadow (67-133 %), chase (133-200 %), waste (beyond), on coordinates normalised by the plate half-width plus a ball radius and the batter's zone height.
